description: Live preview of the rendered email with desktop/mobile device toggles and HTML/plain-text view switching. Includes a sample-data editor (with generation) for resolving template variables and surfaces any rendering warnings.

parameters.name: TimeProvider
parameters.description: Clock used for the debounced re-render (overridable in tests).

parameters.name: VariablesJson
parameters.description: Optional variable data (JSON). When null, sample data is generated from the template.

parameters.name: VariablesJsonChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the edited sample data so the host can persist it (for example in the template SampleDataJson).

parameters.name: InitialDevice
parameters.description: Device the preview starts in: Desktop (the document content width), Tablet (768 px) or Mobile (390 px). The user can switch afterwards. Defaults to Desktop.

parameters.name: ShowSampleDataEditor
parameters.description: When true (the default) the "Edit data" button opens the sample-data editor (TmCodeEditor with JSON validation). A send/preview-only page turns it off.

parameters.name: ShowViewToggle
parameters.description: When true (the default) the toolbar offers the HTML / plain-text switch. A send page that shows only the HTML turns it off.

parameters.name: FooterActions
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the end of the preview toolbar — for example "Send test email". The preview itself never sends anything.

parameters.name: CultureName
parameters.description: Culture the preview should be rendered in (for example cs-CZ); null keeps the renderer default (the document language, otherwise the invariant culture).
